# Foundation For Endangered Languages (FEL)

> A global organization dedicated to preventing language extinction through grants, community engagement, and linguistic documentation.

FEL is an international charity that funds language preservation projects, maintains a community of linguists and activists, and publishes research on endangered languages and revitalization strategies. The organization provides grants, hosts annual conferences, and distributes the Ogmios newsletter to advance linguistic diversity and sustainable development.
